title: Smith Rondo / Weapon Master cycle (Seasonal)
summary: Defeat the Weapon Master and his apprentices, then face Smith Rondo.
overview: Bring Rondo the four broken weapon components to summon Weapon Master Vtiink Vzaan and four apprentices. Rondo becomes vulnerable after the Weapon Master dies.
Rondo transforms at 65% health. His attackable stage has a 45-minute timer, after which he returns home and becomes protected again.

phases.label: Weapon Master and apprentices
phases.description: The Weapon Master calls idle apprentices onto his target every six seconds. Apprentice replacement signals schedule their return after one minute.

phases.label: Smith Rondo
phases.description: Rondo stands, loses his damage protection and begins his timed combat stage.

phases.label: Transformation
phases.description: Rondo changes into a larger corrupted form. The script does not define a new damage ability at this threshold.

sections.title: Starting components
paragraphs: Turn in all four required weapon components to Rondo together.

sections.title: Completion
paragraphs: Rondo's death creates his spectral memory for the follow-up. The component turn-in also records temporary presence credit for participating characters.

sections.title: Seasonal behavior
paragraphs: Theta Sigma offers the seasonal expedition. Rondo keeps the Weapon Master sequence and 65% transformation, with additional messages and a seasonal fragment appearing after his defeat. Leaving combat resets his appearance and the 65% trigger.
